εὐσχημόνως

decorously, becomingly: 1Co.14:40; περιπατεῖν, Rom.13:13, 1Th.4:12.†

elsewhere.note: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
Let all things be done decently and in order.
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
